reviews.title: Misleading Casino Feel, Horse-Racing Reality!
reviews.text:
Read the licensing and platform disclosures very carefully before depositing money.

I initially believed I was playing an online casino product similar to traditional slot machines. After contacting customer service regarding payouts, I was informed that the platform is actually based on horse-race wagering and pari-mutuel betting, with the slot-style games serving as a presentation layer for those wagers.

In my opinion, that distinction is not obvious from the marketing. Consumers who see influencers promoting the platform from casino floors, standing in front of slot machines, may reasonably assume they are playing a traditional online casino product with slot-style odds and payouts.

That is not what I understood after speaking with customer service.

My experience was that the payouts were far smaller than I expected based on the amount wagered. Had I fully understood that I was participating in a horse-racing wagering platform rather than a conventional online casino, I likely would have made different decisions about how much money to deposit.

Before you play, make sure you understand exactly what type of wagering product this is, how winnings are calculated, and what odds are actually driving the results.
